preflight: xcodebuild test-without-building with the focal QuataIosFeedPlaybackUITests method
notes: This postflight closes the SCR-FEED shared root for loading, empty, error, retry and populated states on the current product tree. The stable feed.root anchor remains mounted across those states.

Web/Wasm executes the two common root-state tests and mounts the authenticated read-only Feed route from the production distribution. Compose/Wasm does not expose feed.root as a stable DOM node, so the browser report does not claim direct DOM observation of that tag.

Android executes the root, loading, empty, error and two retry dispatches through one focal instrumented test. iOS executes the same common root-state tests through iosX64Test and observes feed.root in the existing playback fixture before operating play, pause, mute and unmute.
Live, Ranking, focused detail, comments, profile entry, media transport and Feed mutations keep their existing owners and evidence. This postflight does not recertify or broaden them.
No backend mutation was needed. Web revoked its hermetic sessions; Android and iOS used local fixtures without remote product data.
Raw local reports, screenshots, host paths, simulator identifiers and logs remain unversioned. The committed evidence files are sanitized projections bound to local source hashes.

Independent review found that the populated common test only proved absence of loading/status chrome. Product SHA 9e726077 now requires the exact post text feed-root-visible to be displayed and locks that assertion in the fast contract. The affected Wasm focal test passed; iOS common test compilation passed on Windows while execution remained SKIPPED on that host, so the versioned iOS simulator evidence stays bound to reportGitHead 5a8c42f2 and no renewed iOS execution is claimed.

Any executable, workflow, runner, source, resource, test, configuration or dependency change after productSha invalidates the affected evidence; attestation-only documentation remains subject to scripts/validate-candidate-attestation.mjs.
